question: When and where should the ritual bathing be performed?
premises: Bathing is prescribed as a prior act
The location is the pool named Dhruva
The time is the full-moon day in the month of Āśvina
inference: One should bathe in the pool named Dhruva on the full-moon day in Āśvina.
plain_english: Having bathed in the pool named Dhruva on the full-moon day in the month of Āśvina.
